principle: CONSERVAR -> ENTENDER -> ENVOLVER -> PROBAR -> MEJORAR -> MIGRAR

SALE-001.reason: LEAD-NATIVE already emits SALES_PRIORITY_READY and COM-001 already declares SALE-001 as upstream. Missing piece is a deterministic sales decision/cadence/objection contract, not a parallel CRM.

COM-001.reason: Existing com-delivery-router-v1 already provides deterministic channel routing, permission fail-closed, quiet hours, dedupe and adapter gating. Do not duplicate it.

NOTIF-001.reason: Notification ownership is already declared by COM delivery router; extend grouping/priority/digest semantics after SALE->COM contract is green.

C360-001.reason: LEAD strict adoption already consumes C360-001. Build a non-duplicating projection/data contract over existing App/CRM sources.

VOICE-001.reason: Existing VOICE/VOICEUI work must be reused. Real outbound telephony remains separately gated by consent, provider binding, legal and cost policy.
